purpose: Teach: ヒデ/オト/ヨハネ/チャールズ/アラン/エホバ/トーマス/ケリー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがX JAPANのヒデのドキュメンタリーを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a documentary about Hide from X Japan.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone. Soft opening. Speaking to her son with gentle informality, as though sharing an observation rather than making an announcement. Slight lift at the end — natural, conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとオトちゃんが居る公園で遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played in the park with Dad and Oto-chan today.
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of words. Immediate. A child breathless to share something he's been holding. Slight hop-skip energy in the delivery. Eyes probably wide.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが聖書のヨハネの黙示録を解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is explaining the Book of Revelation to us.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective observation. Slower pace than before. Thoughtful spacing between phrases. Not distant — present but contemplative, as though noticing something about her husband. Gentle exhale quality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと英王室のチャールズ国王の戴冠式観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched King Charles's coronation together.
lines.style: Quick, proud announcement. Words tumble out in order of importance to him. Genuine excitement without perform—just the simple joy of shared attention with his father. Clean, unselfconscious delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアラン・ドロンの主演映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a film with Alain Delon in it.
lines.style: Same reflective quality as before. Slightly longer pause before speaking. Watching her son, watching her husband — this is her noticing the pattern of his attention. Grounded, accepting tone. No judgment, just attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「エホバの証人の方は親切」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that Jehovah's Witnesses are really kind people.
lines.style: Earnest, slower than his previous lines. He's working to express something he's been thinking about. Respectful of what he learned. Not babbling — careful. The tone of a child who understood he was being told something important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが機関車トーマスの劇場版を観に連れて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is taking you to see Thomas the Tank Engine at the cinema.
lines.style: Warm, present, a small note of pleasure in her voice. She's delivering good news to her son. Gentle emphasis on 'taking you'—she notices his father's kindness. Soft pace, natural rhythm of a mother sharing something nice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとケリー国務長官の演説聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to hear Secretary of State Kerry give a speech.
lines.style: Breathless closing statement. Pride and wonder mixing together. The child is still processing that something so large and adult happened and he was there. Slight trailing upswing at the end — amazement.
